purpose: Supplement locked random holdout with branch-targeted unseen stress layouts before inspecting final random-holdout summaries. Uniform-area random layouts rarely exercise all-negative origin switching.
generation: 10-16 unique channels, source radial distance uniform [1600,1800], receive radius uniform [1000,1500]. Alternating two families: independent full-circle angles, or angles within +/-0.06 rad around a random centre direction. Thus no source is receivable at the origin. Four same deterministic error fields per layout.
cases: 20 new layouts x 4 error fields = 80 configurations; same five locked variants in bounded and rounding batches
interpretation: Targeted stress validation, report separately from the original 50-layout uniform-area holdout. No tuning/selection using either validation set; do not pool them as an estimate of the official distribution.
stop: Finish these fixed validation batches, retain all failures and regressions; no new search after seeing outcomes.
